meta.name: ozor-doc-to-video
meta.description: Convert any document into a production-ready Ozor.ai video prompt. Use this skill whenever the user uploads a document (PDF, PowerPoint, Google Doc, Markdown, text file, or URL) and wants to turn it into a video. Also trigger when the user mentions 'turn this doc into a video', 'make a video from this PDF', 'video from my pitch deck', 'convert this presentation to video', 'video from this blog post', 'video from these release notes', 'create a video from this document', 'turn this into an explainer', or any request to transform written content into video format using Ozor. This skill reads the document, extracts the core message, structures it into scenes, and outputs a complete prompt the user can paste directly into Ozor.ai.
